strings.level.learning.orientation.title: Getting Oriented
strings.level.learning.orientation.description: Start exploring, then return to something once enough time has passed.
strings.level.learning.foundation.title: Foundation Set
strings.level.learning.foundation.description: A first group of items has survived a delayed review.
strings.level.learning.application.title: Putting It to Work
strings.level.learning.application.description: Your recall is becoming useful beyond a first encounter.
strings.level.learning.integration.title: Connections Forming
strings.level.learning.integration.description: More of the lexicon is staying available when you need it.
strings.level.learning.durable.title: Built to Last
strings.level.learning.durable.description: A substantial body of knowledge has held up across delayed reviews.
strings.level.learning.breadth.title: Range and Depth
strings.level.learning.breadth.description: Durable recall now reaches across a broad part of the learning set.
strings.achievement.mastery.durable_memory.title: Built to Last
strings.achievement.mastery.durable_memory.descr: Master unique items after a real delay, not just on first exposure.
strings.achievement.correction.repair_loop.title: Turnaround
strings.achievement.correction.repair_loop.descr: Return to earlier mistakes and correct the same items successfully.
strings.achievement.consistency.weekly_rhythm.de: Build weeks with three meaningful study days—without demanding a perfect daily streak.
Practice across distinct content types instead of staying in one comfortable lane.
strings.achievement.review.queue_resolved.title: Clear the Deck
strings.achievement.review.queue_resolved.descri: Finish a genuine review queue that started with at least five due items.
strings.achievement.mastery.confusable_precision: Reliably tell apart pairs that are easy to confuse, then prove it again later.
Use newly learned items correctly inside a meaningful context.
strings.achievement.challenge.delayed_recall.des: Recall unique items successfully after at least three days away from them.
strings.achievement.comeback.gentle_return.title: Welcome Back, Gently
strings.achievement.comeback.gentle_return.descr: After a week or more away, complete one small session with three meaningful actions.
strings.achievement.reflection.calibrated_confid: Record confidence before the answer and learn to match it to real outcomes.
strings.achievement.collection.learned_not_saved: Turn saved lexicon items into reviewed knowledge instead of an untouched collection.
Discover and master connections across three different morpheme families.
strings.achievement.progress.unique_items: {current} of {target} unique items mastered after a delay
strings.achievement.progress.context_items: {current} of {target} new items used in context
strings.achievement.progress.delayed_items: {current} of {target} items recalled after three days
strings.quest.daily.due_review.title: Review three that are ready
strings.quest.daily.due_review.reason: Give three due items a timely review so the spacing system can do its job.
strings.quest.daily.repair_one.title: Fix one earlier miss
strings.quest.daily.repair_one.reason: Choose one previous mistake and close the loop with a correct attempt.
strings.quest.daily.context_use.title: Use one new item in context
strings.quest.daily.context_use.reason: Move one new item beyond recognition by using it meaningfully.
strings.quest.daily.confusable_pair.title: Separate two close pairs
strings.quest.daily.confusable_pair.reason: Practice two easy-to-confuse pairs until the distinction is clear.
strings.quest.weekly.rhythm_three_days.title: Choose three learning days
strings.quest.weekly.rhythm_three_days.reason: Spread meaningful practice across any three days that fit your week.
strings.quest.weekly.durable_mastery.title: Make eight memories stick
strings.quest.weekly.durable_mastery.reason: Master eight unique items after enough time has passed to test real recall.
strings.quest.weekly.mixed_practice.title: Mix three kinds of practice
strings.quest.weekly.mixed_practice.reason: Switch perspectives by completing three distinct types of learning activity.
strings.quest.weekly.queue_relief.title: Bring the queue back to clear
strings.quest.weekly.queue_relief.reason: Clear a review queue that began with at least five due items.
strings.quest.weekend.focused_review.title: A focused review block
strings.quest.weekend.focused_review.reason: Use part of the weekend to revisit eight items that are actually due.
strings.quest.comeback.restart_small.title: Restart with one small win
strings.quest.comeback.restart_small.reason: After time away, complete three meaningful actions. No lost-streak lecture attached.
strings.quest.monthly.correction_craft.title: Turn mistakes into material
strings.quest.monthly.correction_craft.reason: Repair 25 unique earlier mistakes and keep the evidence of what changed.
strings.quest.monthly.durable_growth.title: Grow what stays with you
strings.quest.monthly.durable_growth.reason: Master 30 unique items after at least three days between learning and recall.
